notes.note: Not self-containable with a real ASN.1 module; the helper module stands for the explicit TTCN-3 view (mapping) of the ASN.1 source (option 3 of clause 8.2.3.6). Tests only that a TTCN-3:2010 module accepts an import with a non-TTCN-3 language specification.
Titan does not check language specifications of imports (accepts the reject test).
Titan does not check TTCN-3 edition ordering of imports (accepts the reject test).

Reading 1 chosen: editions compared by date ('TTCN-3:2023' in the import is later than the importing module's 'TTCN-3:2010'). Source module has no language specification so only rule c) is violated. Titan does not check this.
Reading 1 chosen: the friend module named in the declaration does not exist at all.
Only checks that the module is accepted; whether a tool issues at most a warning (not more) cannot be expressed in TTCN-3.

That a friend declaration is always private is not directly observable; the test checks that an explicitly private friend declaration is equivalent to the default one, i.e. it still grants friendship.
Reading 1 chosen: 'friend definitions' = friend module declarations; declaring one with friend visibility is rejected.
Reading 1 chosen: definitions imported by an import statement without visibility are not re-imported via 'import all' of the import statements.
Tests that public and friend definitions inside (nested) groups are directly importable like ungrouped ones; group-import cases are covered by the 8.3 table 9 tests.

Equivalence is checked by importing a control part as 'function control' and invoking it like a parameterless function. Titan rejects: it does not support importing/invoking module control functions (V4.17.1 feature).
Titan does not import friend import statements into friend modules via 'import all' of import statements; per table 10 the import is imported, so the test is kept.
Plain reading chosen: two control parts in one module are rejected.
The helper's control part is invoked as 'control()' from a function called by the entry module's control part. Titan rejects: no support for explicit control function invocation.
Titan rejects: no support for importing/invoking module control functions with module prefix.
